title: The World Started Deleting Itself

noob.caption: #FFD23F
noob.acting: bright, fast, cheerful cartoon character, impulsive and oblivious, great comic timing

steve.caption: #3FE0D0
steve.acting: calm, low, dry and deadpan; a practical survivor who rarely raises his voice

patch.caption: #B6F0FF
patch.acting: calm, literal, slightly too quiet; announces disasters politely

void.caption: #FF3BD4
void.acting: unseen: the void copying the Noob's own voice

movie_note: Movie Episode 6 (the creator's rewritten 16:9 blueprint, 2026-11-27; story/movie/ep06_shots.md): picks up Ep5's last instant; an unseen Void Wall (no Null on screen) erases the dragon, the pickaxe, the Noob's wall and the TNT in turn (Ep5's erase rule and sound); Patch: 'Stop throwing things at it! It's not attacking... it's correcting.'; the Noob's '...Hi?' to the black, copied back by the void in his own voice; the wall surges, Patch warps them out in a cyan flash straight into Ep7's Memory Grid. REALITY 71 -> 66 -> 62 -> 57 -> 52. The original takes for the original lines (movie/ep06_published); new takes only for the added lines (Steve's '...No wall.', Patch's 'Stop throwing things at it!' and 'Hold still- I'm pulling us out!', the Noob's 'It's copying me!'); the void's '...Hi?' is made from the Noob's own take.

low pulsing industrial tension, no melody, under the attempts; out dead with the TNT

events.note: Ep5's last instant goes on: the Noob on the blue terrace (scared, hammer in his right hand), Steve on the grey pad's edge, Patch near the Noob, the sealed dragon overhead, the open door, the empty spawn ring; void wind. Shot 1 (28 mm, low, behind Steve and the Noob looking up at the dragon; slow push-in)

beyond where Ep5's stones vanished, a towering pitch-black Void Rift (jagged edge crackling with magenta checkerboard, cubic debris tearing off) rolls across the blue sky; the arena drops into overcast shadow (sky strength -50%, a magenta-violet area light on the wall)
the wall's leading edge touches the sealed dragon: Ep5's erase rule, tail to head, into rising dead pixels; REALITY 71 -> 66

events.name: noob_delete
events.direction_text: [panicked, shouting] The world is DELETING itself!
events.note: the original take; panicked, looking up as the last pixels rise
Shot 2 (50 mm MCU on Steve, the void's magenta rim on his face): his eyes track the last falling pixels, then harden; he shifts into a combat stance, the diamond pickaxe in both hands

events.name: steve_stop
events.direction_text: [calm, flat, determined] Then we stop it.
events.note: the original take; grim, firm
Shot 3A (35 mm, three-quarter front on Steve): he winds up, twists his torso
the overhand throw, left to right; Shot 3B (40 mm side tracking): the pickaxe spins along its arc (-720 deg over 12 frames) across the open gap toward the wall
it hits the dark boundary: a 4-frame hit-freeze mid-air, checkerboard, implodes in silence; REALITY 66 -> 62
cut to Steve's stunned blink; he looks down at his empty hands

events.name: steve_pick
events.note: the original take; deflated, staring at his empty hands
Shot 4 (32 mm wide two-shot: the Noob's blue terrace left, the wall creeping in from the right): the Noob raises his BTools hammer (parented to Hand.R, nothing at the hip)

events.name: noob_wall
events.note: the original take; determined
the hammer comes down: a crisp cyan wireframe on the terrace's front edge, a thick stone barrier drops in with a thud; his confident grin
the wall glides straight into the barrier
one continuous checkerboard dissolve, bottom to top, nothing left floating; his grin drops to disbelief
the empty edge; a beat

events.name: steve_nowall

he hurls it overhand toward the void; Shot 5B (35 mm wide, the Noob on the left third, the TNT on the right two-thirds): the fuse sizzles louder as it flies, the block swelling white
at its brightest white flash, the void's glitch field snatches it: checkerboard, gone; dead silence on that frame, then a faint dry blip-vacuum; REALITY 62 -> 57
